show.description:
After five years, Shourya plans to meet Divya and surprise her by revealing his secret. But instead, Divya gives Surya a shocking blow. As her position rises, Divya changes completely. What does Surya do then? What is the connection between Surya and Alia?
Watch 'Billionaire Boyfriend’s Revenge' exclusively on Kuku TV.
